description: Public-benchmark-style questions: MMLU-style knowledge choices and GSM8K-style word problems, written fresh in the same style and difficulty. An anchor for comparing scores across versions.
name: Anchor

tasks.prompt:
Which organ in the human body produces insulin?
A. Liver
B. Pancreas
C. Spleen
D. Kidney Answer with the full text of the correct option.

Which gas do plants absorb from the air for photosynthesis?
A. Oxygen
B. Nitrogen
C. Carbon dioxide
D. Hydrogen Answer with the full text of the correct option.

Which of these is a prime number?
A. 21
B. 27
C. 29
D. 33 Answer with the full text of the correct option.

In which year did World War II end?
A. 1918
B. 1936
C. 1945
D. 1950 Answer with the full text of the correct option.

What is the chemical formula for table salt?
A. NaCl
B. KCl
C. CaCO3
D. H2SO4 Answer with the full text of the correct option.

Which planet has the largest ring system?
A. Mars
B. Saturn
C. Venus
D. Mercury Answer with the full text of the correct option.

What do you call an animal that eats only plants?
A. Carnivore
B. Herbivore
C. Omnivore
D. Insectivore Answer with the full text of the correct option.

Which language has the most native speakers?
A. English
B. Hindi
C. Spanish
D. Mandarin Chinese Answer with the full text of the correct option.

What is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
A. Nucleus
B. Ribosome
C. Mitochondrion
D. Golgi body Answer with the full text of the correct option.

Which instrument measures air pressure?
A. Thermometer
B. Barometer
C. Hygrometer

Janet has 3 baskets with 8 oranges in each basket. She eats 5 oranges. How many oranges does she have left?
A book costs $12. Tom buys 4 books and pays with a $100 bill. How much change does he get?
There are 6 shelves with 15 books on each shelf. How many books are there in total?
A car uses 8 liters of fuel per 100 km. How many liters does it use for 350 km?
Sara reads 12 pages every day. Her book has 204 pages. How many days does she need to finish it?
A baker sells cupcakes for $3 each. He sells 27 cupcakes in the morning and 18 in the afternoon. How much money does he make?
Tom is 4 times as old as his son. His son is 9 years old. How old is Tom?
A tank holds 500 liters. It is filled at 25 liters per minute. How many minutes does it take to fill it?
A school has 14 classes with 26 students in each class. How many students are there in total?
Lily saves $15 per week. How much has she saved after 8 weeks?
